1.name: Strategy 1 (Old default)
1.description: Old base strategy, kept only for comparison. Not recommended as the first live strategy.

2.name: Strategy 2 (Early extreme momentum)
2.description: Uses the T120 large-gap signal as an early momentum observation strategy. Backtest sample is small; do not use as the small live main strategy yet.

3.name: Recommended: T25 P95 gap20 fixed $1
3.description: Currently the most promising conservative strategy for small live validation: within T25, buy probability 95%-99%, buy gap >= 20, fixed $1. After merging the old and new simulation streams and filtering, 269 trades: 267 wins, 2 losses; fixed $1 stakes scaled $10 to about $13.17, max drawdown about -$1.88; still not a profit guarantee. Live trading must be checked for fill rate and slippage.

4.name: Observation: T25 P95 gap0 fixed $1
4.description: Higher-opportunity high-probability comparison strategy: within T25, probability >= 95%, no buy-gap requirement. Old simulation signals: about 259 trades, 256 wins, 3 losses. Slightly lower returns and more exposed to small-gap reversals; not the first live strategy yet.

5.name: Aggressive observation: T25 P95 10% fraction
5.description: Same P95 signals but staking 10% of balance. Backtest returns are slightly higher but drawdowns are larger; small balances are limited by the $1 minimum stake. Observation only before live trading; do not enable now.
